limitations: Constructed realistic client-consumable catalog; not a captured reporter catalog or proof of any installed client/server configuration.

Eleven selected public native OpenCode tools plus all 131 unique-named GitHub MCP committed tool snapshots at pinned revision, and 88 explicit second-instance aliases; aliases have identical schemas/descriptions to their source tools.

Source snapshot directory may contain deprecated/conditional tools, so the 131-source set is a schema workload rather than a claim that one default GitHub MCP server advertises all 131 simultaneously.
Duplicate-named variant snapshots are deduplicated, preferring the canonical <tool-name>.snap file; output-only snapshots are excluded.
OpenCode native descriptions are public source templates, without expanding installed agent or skill metadata.
No model calls, credentials, user configuration, SDK transcripts, or client requests were read.
